description: Paozhu C++20 web framework on standalone Asio, built from the upstream mini_project.sh clean scaffold. Annotated controller routes answer /baseline11, /baseline2, /pipeline, /echo, /json/{count}?m={multiplier}, /delay/{ms}, /async-db?min=&max=&limit= and /fortunes; the dataset is parsed once at startup and serialized per request, /echo returns the raw request body byte-for-byte, and the DB routes use paozhu's own async Postgres driver. /static/* is served by the framework's native static path from the mounted /data/static (wwwpath=/data) with an on-disk compression cache pre-warmed at startup. Two server instances share the image: plaintext HTTP/1.1 on :8080 and ALPN h2 on :8443, plus a second instance whose TLS listener on :8081 advertises only http/1.1 for json-tls, 8gbit and static-tls and whose cleartext :8082 listener serves h2c prior-knowledge for baseline-h2c and json-h2c.
